purpose: Approved scene header navigation: two edit views and a version-specific review entry

variants.name: focus
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: high-fidelity Chinese desktop creative app UI mockup.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, not a loose inspiration.
Change ONLY the shallow top navigation bar (the top approximately 64 px), keep every other area of the supplied image unchanged. Retain exact 1586 x 992 canvas, dark gray style, same sharp Chinese font, same amber accent. Preserve all photos, faces, media crops, card positions, labels, sidebars, lower controls, and bottom content as closely as possible.

Top bar redesign, with exact text:
- Preserve the small logo at far left and breadcrumb "旧钥匙 / 第1集 / 咖啡厅" in the same left area.
- Immediately after the breadcrumb, with a small gap and subtle separator, put TWO compact view tabs: "镜头制作" (selected, amber underline) and "剪辑" (unselected).
- Remove the original equal tabs "制作", "剪辑", "审阅" from their old positions. In particular there must be NO third review tab.
- Right align a quiet play icon and text "预览整场", followed by a single compact thin-outline review entry with exact text "审阅稿 v1 · 待修改". The entire review entry is one clickable-looking outlined control, the status may be subdued amber; do not make it another selected view.
- Fit everything in the original single top bar height; keep generous unused middle space, clean alignment. Do not add another header row.
All other content below the top bar is locked. Do not redesign or simplify the body. No annotations, captions, arrows, outer frame or mockup device.
